title: Nourishing Sour Syrian Galangal Stew
description: A sour and flavorful Syrian stew featuring galangal, perfect for a crowd, made in a hot pot vessel and grilled to perfection with a yakimono grill, Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced galangal, sumac, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
Grill the stew for 5 minutes, or until the galangal is caramelized and the sauce is thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
